title: Review of Salary, Workload and Progression Pathways for Early Childhood Educators
what_it_is: Review of Salary, Workload and Progression Pathways for Early Childhood Educators

sections.label: Early childhood educator salary review
sections.summary: Salary review for early childhood educators expected to complete in fourth quarter of 2022, with changes from 2023 and expanded career pathways.

sentences.speaker: Dr Wan Rizal
sentences.text: asked the Minister for Social and Family Development (a) what is the estimated timeline for completion of the salary review of early childhood educators under the Early Childhood Development Agency; and (b) whether the review will include implementing measures to manage the workload and provide pathways and progressions for career development.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: There is an ongoing salary review for early childhood (EC) educators which we expect to complete in the fourth quarter of 2022.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: ECDA intends to work with Government-supported operators to implement the changes from 2023 onwards.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: The review will ensure our educators’ salaries are commensurate with their contributions and professional skills, while being competitive enough to attract and retain talent in the sector.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: Career pathways have also been expanded so that educators can aspire towards larger or new roles, such as Lead Early Years Educator, Deputy Centre Leader and Curriculum Specialist.

sections.label: ECDA workplace safety recommendations
sections.summary: ECDA works with preschools to adopt Occupational Health and Safety Assessment recommendations for educators' physical and mental well-being.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: ECDA is also working with preschools to adopt recommendations from the Occupational Health and Safety Assessment for the EC sector to ensure our educators’ physical and mental well-being are well taken care of.

sections.label: Digitalisation in preschool sector
sections.summary: Digitalisation efforts and shared applications are being onboarded with preschools across the sector.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: All these things today can be done through digitalisation efforts and we have been working with preschools to onboard them in applications that can be shared across the whole preschool sector.

sections.label: Educator physical well-being and pay relativity
sections.summary: Preschools asked to provide proper desks and seats, and relativity among jobs maintained for competitive pay.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: It is not good for their back and their physical well-being in the long term.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: So, apart from encouraging them to basically take a proper chair or stool when they teach, we have also asked preschools to provide proper desks and seats so that, during their downtime, they can actually sit in an office environment where it is suited for them and not a classroom where there are only low stools and chairs where they continue to do their work.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: Members who are interested can file a Parliamentary Question on it.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: But, certainly, there is a relativity among all jobs and all job families that we want to maintain, not just between educators, but also across many other jobs families so that there is balance between what we pay for their skills and contributions and being competitive enough that they do not move across because they are portable across some skills.
